description: Mark the secrets the spec leaves as plain strings sensitive. Env var `value` on create, replace and update: the spec calls it "The value of the environment variable. Will be encrypted at rest", and reads only return a masked `preview_secret`. Service token `key`: the spec calls it "The raw service token. It will only be exposed this one time". Temporary proxy credential `key` (`POST /v1/proxy/credentials`): the spec says it can access the proxy on behalf of the caller for a limited time (the hosted API answered 405 "Method POST not supported" on 2026-11-12, so this one is from the spec alone). Ingest key `url` on create and list: observed live 2026-11-12, both responses return `https://bt-ik-<key>@api.braintrust.dev/...`, the ingest key itself as the URL's userinfo.
